tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Xero organisation ID. Leave blank to use the first available tenant.

skip_validation_errors.title: Continue on Error
skip_validation_errors.description: When enabled, records that fail Xero validation are skipped with a warning. When disabled (default), the job fails if any record has validation errors.

create_errors_table.title: Create Errors Table
create_errors_table.description: When enabled, records that fail Xero validation are written to an output table 'validation_errors' with columns: entity_type, record_id, errors.

reload_all_mappings.title: Reload All Mappings
reload_all_mappings.description: Auto-match columns for all configured endpoints based on their input tables.

write_mode.title: Write Mode
write_mode.description: Create: add new records only. Upsert: create or update by Xero ID or reference.

source_table.title: Input Table Name
source_table.description: The destination name of the input table as configured in storage mapping.

column_mapping.title: Column Mapping
column_mapping.description: Maps your input table columns to Xero field names. Click Reload All Mappings to auto-fill.

options.tooltip:
Maps your **Source Column** to the target **Xero Field Name**.

Click **Reload All Mappings** (above the endpoints list) to auto-fill based on your input table columns.

Nested Xero objects are flattened with underscore notation — e.g. `Address_City` represents the `city` field inside the `addresses` object. See the [Xero API documentation](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/overview) for field definitions.

Non-essential fields with no matching source column can be deleted.
